name: testing-best-practices
title_zh: 先问这条测试删掉会不会有人哭的 Laravel 测试
tagline_zh: 写测试最怕的是覆盖率高但全是摆设：断言只写 assertOk、数据随手 factory 造、依赖全真连。
tagline_en: High coverage full of filler tests? It reviews coverage choice, naming, assertions, test data, dependency.
desc_en: Laravel test design and review. Use when selecting coverage, naming or structuring tests, choosing assertions or test data, isolating dependencies, testing HTTP or security boundaries, improving suite performance, or reviewing test value. Use framework guidance or search-docs for Pest and PHPUnit syntax.
why_zh: 它不教语法，只审设计：先问这条测试在保护什么行为，再决定断言写多深、依赖该不该假。
why_en: It doesn't teach syntax, it reviews design: what behavior does this test protect, how deep should the assertion go, should this.
limit_zh: 只管测试设计与评审，不写业务代码也不替你跑测试；Pest 和 PHPUnit 的具体语法、配置。
limit_en: Test design and review only — no business code, no test runs. Pest/PHPUnit syntax, config, and errors get redirected to framework docs or.
title_en: Laravel test review that asks who'd cry if a test were.
